messages.text: Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin almost 1k and no ethernet ?

It's $999 and mines both chains — Bitcoin and Doge/Litecoin in one box, ships November 14. No ethernet cable in the box; the Power Kit dropped it too, so plan on one you already have.

What's the plan — first miner, or adding to a setup you're already running?
